headline: Kyrgyzstan to introduce mandatory registration of airline ticket offices
summary: Kyrgyzstan will introduce mandatory registration for companies and entrepreneurs that book and sell air tickets. The mechanism will be rolled out in stages, starting with a first phase.
why: Regulation of ticket sellers affects airline distribution channels and consumer protection in the travel market.
original_headline: В Кыргызстане введут обязательную регистрацию авиакасс
